conceptBreakdown.heading: 4.1 Quantitative Estimation Formulas
conceptBreakdown.title: 4.1 Quantitative Estimation Formulas
conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
QUANTITATIVE ESTIMATION FORMULAS MATRIX

• Carbon: % C = (12 / 44) × (Mass of CO₂ / Mass of Sample) × 100
• Hydrogen: % H = (2 / 18) × (Mass of H₂O / Mass of Sample) × 100
• Dumas Nitrogen: % N = (28 / 22400) × (V_N2 at STP in mL / Mass of Sample) × 100
• Kjeldahl Nitrogen: % N = (1.4 × N_acid × V_acid used for NH3 in mL) / (Mass of Sample in g)
• Carius Halogen: % X = (M_X / M_AgX) × (Mass of AgX / Mass of Sample) × 100
• Carius Sulfur: % S = (32 / 233.36) × (Mass of BaSO₄ / Mass of Sample) × 100
• Carius Phosphorus: % P = (62 / 222) × (Mass of Mg₂P₂O₇ / Mass of Sample) × 100
conceptBreakdown.content:
1. **Liebig Method**: Organic compound combusted with $\text{CuO}$. $\text{CO}_2$ absorbed in conc. $\text{KOH}$; $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ absorbed in anhydrous $\text{CaCl}_2$.
2. **Dumas Method**: Nitrogen converted to dry $\text{N}_2$ gas collected over concentrated $\text{KOH}$ solution at STP ($0^\circ\text{C}, 1\text{ atm}$).
3. **Kjeldahl Method**: Digested with conc. $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4 \to (\text{NH}_4)_2\text{SO}_4 \xrightarrow{\text{NaOH}} \text{NH}_3 \uparrow$ absorbed in known excess standard acid.
4. **Carius Method**: Digested with fuming $\text{HNO}_3$ in sealed Carius tube forming $\text{AgX}$ for halogens, $\text{BaSO}_4$ for sulfur, and $\text{Mg}_2\text{P}_2\text{O}_7$ for phosphorus.

conceptBreakdown.heading: 4.2 Kjeldahl Method Structural Limitations (NEST Trap)
conceptBreakdown.title: 4.2 Kjeldahl Method Structural Limitations (NEST Trap)
conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
KJELDAHL FAILURE CONDITIONS

The Kjeldahl method FAILS for compounds containing Nitrogen in:
1. Nitro groups (-NO₂, e.g., Nitrobenzene)
2. Azo groups (-N=N-, e.g., Azobenzene)
3. Stable aromatic heterocyclic rings (e.g., Pyridine, Quinoline, Pyrrole)

Reason: Nitrogen in these groups does not form (NH₄)₂SO₄ during digestion. Use Dumas method!
conceptBreakdown.content: The Kjeldahl method **FAILS** for Nitro compounds ($-\text{NO}_2$), Azo compounds ($-\text{N=N}-$), and Nitrogen present in a stable aromatic ring (*Pyridine, Quinoline, Pyrrole*) because nitrogen is not quantitatively converted into Ammonium Sulfate during acid digestion. The **Dumas method** must be utilized for such compounds.

quickRevision: Dumas method collects dry N₂ gas over KOH solution.
Kjeldahl method measures NH₃ via acid neutralization.
Kjeldahl fails for nitrobenzene, azobenzene, and pyridine.
Carius method estimates S as BaSO₄ and halogens as AgX.
